DAT-01.sentence: Disk encryption and KMS-managed keys protect all databases and file storage, in line with our encryption at rest standard.

DAT-02.sentence: All customer traffic uses encryption in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher, and HTTPS is enforced on every public endpoint.

DAT-03.sentence: Data retention periods are defined in the contract, and customer data is deleted within 30 days of termination using secure deletion.

DAT-04.sentence: The privacy programme meets GDPR requirements, and PII is processed only under a data processing agreement.

DAT-05.sentence: Backups are taken regularly and kept offsite, but restore tests are informal.

GOV-01.sentence: A written security policy covers all staff, and management approval is renewed at each annual policy review.

GOV-02.sentence: Security roles and responsibilities are documented, and a named security officer reports to the executive team.

GOV-03.sentence: A risk assessment is performed every year and after major changes, and findings are tracked in a risk register with risk treatment plans.

IAM-01.sentence: Access to systems and customer data follows an access control policy based on least privilege and role-based access.

IAM-02.sentence: All workforce accounts use MFA through the company single sign-on provider, with strong authentication on administrative interfaces.

IAM-03.sentence: Privileged access is limited to a small group of approved staff, and administrator accounts are separate, logged and reviewed.

IAM-04.sentence: Quarterly review of access rights is enforced, with automated deprovisioning as part of staff offboarding.

OPS-01.sentence: Security-relevant events are sent to a central SIEM for logging, and audit logs are kept for twelve months under our log retention rule.

OPS-02.sentence: Vulnerability scanning is run for most systems, and patching is handled ad hoc.

OPS-04.sentence: Security groups restrict traffic between environments, and a web application firewall and intrusion detection protect public endpoints.

PEO-01.sentence: Awareness training is given to new hires, and a phishing simulation is on the roadmap.

PEO-02.sentence: Pre-employment screening includes reference checks and a criminal record check for roles with access to customer data.

RES-01.sentence: A documented incident response plan defines roles and severity levels, and a tabletop exercise tests it every year.

RES-02.sentence: The company will notify customers through an incident notification within 72 hours, and affected customers receive regular updates.

RES-03.sentence: Business continuity and disaster recovery plans set an RTO of four hours and an RPO of one hour, and are tested every year.

SDL-01.sentence: Software follows a secure development lifecycle in which every change gets a code review and SAST runs in the pipeline.

SDL-02.sentence: A change advisory board approves releases, and peer-reviewed changes move through the deployment pipeline.

TPR-01.sentence: A subprocessor list is kept, and vendor risk reviews are informal.

TPR-02.sentence: A current independent audit confirms the in-scope services, and the attestation report is available to customers on request.
